before: Sync window ended; saved AI not checked; prepare and stop preparation disabled.
afterLookup: Lookup/preparation result unconfirmed; preparation/stop disabled. UI says acquisition will not occur and advises recheck without resending.
afterRecheck: Same visible screen as after lookup (identical capture hash); recheck completion is not established.
screens: Ephemeral local /private/tmp screenshots, not included in Git.
independentReview: Separate reviewer inspected three screens: displayed unconfirmed and disabled states corroborated. Screens alone do not establish tap counts, no network/acquisition, device identity, app version, foreground restore or unchanged existing data.
limitations: No claim of successful lookup, prepared model, same-job execution, mii hardware, physical OS or full data preservation verification; no data or credentials inventoried.
